# Findings govulncheck reports that have no fix available upstream.
#
# The weekly scan compares what it finds against this list and fails only on
# something new. A job that is red every week for reasons nobody can act on is
# a job people stop reading.
#
# Remove an entry when a fixed version appears and the dependency is updated —
# the scan will then be silent about it, and loud again if it comes back.
#
# Empty since Helm 3.22. The four that used to be here went with the modules
# that carried them: Helm stopped depending on containerd, and signs charts
# with github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto rather than golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp.
#
# The x/crypto module is still required, for bcrypt, so scanners that read the
# module list rather than the code still report GO-2026-5932 against it. That
# one is answered in .vex/, not here: govulncheck does not report it, because
# the package is not compiled in, and CI keeps it that way.
